title: What If a Jumbo Jet Lost All Four Engines? One Flight Did

scenes.text: What if all four engines on a jumbo jet quit over the ocean? One flight survived exactly that.
On June 24, 1982, British Airways Flight 9 flew into a volcanic ash cloud near Java at about 37,000 feet.
Within minutes, all four engines failed. There were 263 people on board.
The 747 glided for well over ten minutes, covering about 15 kilometers for every kilometer of height it lost.
Below the ash cloud, the crew managed to restart the engines.
They landed safely in Jakarta. All 263 people survived the longest glide by a jumbo jet caused by volcanic ash.

description:
What if a jumbo jet lost all four engines?
In 1982, British Airways Flight 9 flew into volcanic ash, glided for well over ten minutes, restarted its engines and landed safely with all 263 people.
